# ShopBot Index

> ShopBot Index is an independent weekly index of what online stores tell AI shopping agents. Every Monday it checks 2179 retailers and stores (2549 websites): Shopify stores, big retailers and other retailers & marketplaces. The headline measure is whether each one publishes a UCP profile, the profile AI shopping agents read, at /.well-known/ucp.

Latest crawl: 2026-10-26. In ShopBot Index's crawl of 26 October 2026, 773 of the 1552 retailers and stores we could check publish a UCP profile, the profile AI shopping agents read (49.8%). By segment: Shopify stores 713 of 908 (78.5%), big retailers 11 of 201 (5.5%) and other retailers & marketplaces 49 of 443 (11.1%). We couldn't check 627 of the 2179 we track (blocked or unreachable), so they aren't counted, and we re-check every store each Monday.

How to read the results:
- "UCP profile found": the store publishes a Universal Commerce Protocol profile at /.well-known/ucp and lists what it supports. A UCP profile isn't proof that AI agents can shop at a store.
- "No UCP profile found": we found no profile. It does not mean AI agents can't shop there.
- "Couldn't check": the site refused or failed our requests; excluded from all rates.
- Shares are shares of our list, not of all online stores. Every figure comes from our own crawl.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://shopbotindex.com/): Headline numbers from the latest crawl, by segment, big retailers with a UCP profile, capabilities and payment handlers.
- [All stores](https://shopbotindex.com/stores.html): Every one of the 2179 retailers and stores with its result (the table is drawn with JavaScript; each store also has its own page under /store/).
- [Segments](https://shopbotindex.com/segments/): Shopify stores, big retailers, other retailers & marketplaces, side by side.
- [Shopify stores](https://shopbotindex.com/segments/shopify.html): 713 of 908 checked publish a UCP profile (78.5%).
- [Big retailers](https://shopbotindex.com/segments/big.html): 11 of 201 checked publish a UCP profile (5.5%).
- [Other retailers & marketplaces](https://shopbotindex.com/segments/other.html): 49 of 443 checked publish a UCP profile (11.1%).
- [Capabilities](https://shopbotindex.com/capabilities/): What UCP profiles declare (checkout, cart, catalog search and more), with the stores declaring each.
- [Categories](https://shopbotindex.com/categories/): Results by store category.
- [What changed](https://shopbotindex.com/changes.html): This week compared with the previous crawl: who started or stopped publishing a UCP profile.
- [Check your store](https://shopbotindex.com/check.html): Look up any domain in the latest crawl.
- [Methodology](https://shopbotindex.com/methodology.html): Exactly what we fetch, how, and what the results do and don't mean.
- [AI assistants](https://shopbotindex.com/assistants.html): Which AI assistants name which retailers, from the companies' own announcements, with links.
- [About](https://shopbotindex.com/about.html): Who runs the index and how to contact us.
- [Terms of use](https://shopbotindex.com/terms.html): All rights reserved. Link to pages and quote individual findings with credit and a link; bulk copying or republishing the data needs written permission.

## Data

- One page per store: https://shopbotindex.com/store/<name>.html (all listed in https://shopbotindex.com/sitemap.xml)
- Store lookup used by "Check your store": https://shopbotindex.com/stores.json (domain -> [page slug, store name, result: ucp | no_ucp | couldnt_check, store id])
- Updated every Monday after the crawl. Full text of the key facts and methodology: https://shopbotindex.com/llms-full.txt

## FAQ

- **What is a UCP profile?** A Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) profile is a JSON file a store publishes at `/.well-known/ucp`: the machine-readable profile AI shopping agents read. It lists the protocol version, services, capabilities (for example checkout, cart or catalog search) and payment handlers. [How we check it](https://shopbotindex.com/methodology.html).
- **How many online stores publish a UCP profile?** In our crawl of 26 October 2026, 773 of the 1552 retailers and stores we could check (49.8%). By segment: Shopify stores 713 of 908 (78.5%), big retailers 11 of 201 (5.5%) and other retailers & marketplaces 49 of 443 (11.1%). These are shares of our list of 2179, not of all online stores.
- **Which big retailers publish a UCP profile?** 11 in the crawl of 26 October 2026: Asprey, Debenhams PLC, FAO Schwarz, Farfetch, IKEA, Mexx, On AG, Pepco, Quiksilver, The Body Shop and Zellers. That is 11 of the 201 big retailers we could check. [See all big retailers](https://shopbotindex.com/segments/big.html).
- **What does it mean if a store has no UCP profile?** Only that we found no profile at `/.well-known/ucp`. Some agent shopping runs through a normal web browser or through channels we can't see from outside, such as product feeds shared privately with AI assistants. Equally, a UCP profile isn't proof that AI agents can shop at a store.
- **How often is ShopBot Index updated?** Every week. The crawl runs on Mondays; the latest was on 26 October 2026 and the next is due on 2 November 2026. [See what changed](https://shopbotindex.com/changes.html).
- **How can I check my own store?** Type its domain into [Check your store](https://shopbotindex.com/check.html). It looks the domain up in our latest crawl. If the store isn't in the index yet, email [hello@shopbotindex.com](mailto:hello@shopbotindex.com) and we'll include it in a future crawl.

## Methodology

- **What does ShopBot Index check on each website?** It reads `/robots.txt` first, then fetches `/.well-known/ucp`, where the UCP specification says a business publishes its profile. It also records supporting signals: an MCP endpoint named in the UCP profile, AI-agent rules in robots.txt, `/llms.txt` or `/agents.md`, and schema.org Product markup on one product page. [Details](https://shopbotindex.com/methodology.html#signals).
- **Why are some stores marked "couldn't check"?** Every one of their websites refused our request (401/403/429), timed out, failed TLS or DNS, or disallowed the path in robots.txt. We never try to get around that. These stores are shown separately and left out of adoption rates: 627 of 2179 in the crawl of 26 October 2026.
- **Which stores are tracked?** Three segments, side by side: Shopify stores (1188), Big retailers (297) and Other retailers & marketplaces (694). They come from Wikipedia and Wikidata lists and public lists of Shopify stores. This is not a random sample of all stores, so shares are shares of our list.
- **How many requests does the crawler send?** Usually 10 to 14 per website per week, and never more than 18, one at a time per website, with robots.txt respected for every URL. [How we fetch](https://shopbotindex.com/methodology.html#crawler).
- **How can a website opt out?** Disallow `/` (or just the paths we read) for `ShopBotIndexBot` in robots.txt, or email [hello@shopbotindex.com](mailto:hello@shopbotindex.com).
- **Does ShopBot Index test purchases?** No. We don't test purchases, and we don't score or rank how well a store works with any assistant.

## Contact

hello@shopbotindex.com · https://x.com/ShopBotIndex


## Results by segment (crawl of 2026-10-26)

- Shopify stores (Stores from public lists of Shopify stores.): 1188 tracked, 713 UCP profile found, 195 no UCP profile found, 280 couldn't check; 713 of 908 checked (78.5%).
- Big retailers (Retailers on Wikipedia's List of largest retail companies, or with Wikipedia articles in 10+ languages.): 297 tracked, 11 UCP profile found, 190 no UCP profile found, 96 couldn't check; 11 of 201 checked (5.5%).
- Other retailers & marketplaces (Other retail chains, department stores, supermarkets, hypermarkets and online marketplaces listed on Wikipedia or Wikidata.): 694 tracked, 49 UCP profile found, 394 no UCP profile found, 251 couldn't check; 49 of 443 checked (11.1%).
